checks.text: The page shows the heading "Personal Calendar" and a month grid displaying the current month's days.

Clicking the button "Add event" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Title" with "Team Sync", the field labelled "Date" with "2024-06-15", and the field labelled "Time" with "10:00", then clicking "Save" adds an event to the grid on June 15 that displays "Team Sync".
Clicking the event "Team Sync" on June 15 opens a detail view showing the title "Team Sync", the date "2024-06-15", and the time "10:00".
In the event detail view, clicking the button "Delete" removes the event "Team Sync" from the grid, and the grid no longer displays "Team Sync" on June 15.
Clicking the button "Export ICS" triggers a file download named "calendar.ics" containing the text "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "SUMMARY:Team Sync" if an event exists, or "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" if no events exist.

Clicking the button "Import ICS" and selecting a file containing a valid ICS event with summary "Imported Event" and date "2024-06-20" adds an event to the grid on June 20 that displays "Imported Event".
Clicking the button "Next month" changes the grid to display the next month, and the button "Previous month" changes it back to the current month.
Adding an event with an empty Title and clicking "Save" shows the message "Title is required" and does not add the event to the grid.
Reload keeps the event "Team Sync" visible on June 15 in the month grid after the page is reloaded.
